BUNDLED DENO WINDOWS X64 DISTRIBUTION

This JAR redistributes the unmodified official Deno executable archive as
a separate subprocess runtime for yt-dlp's bundled EJS scripts. Deno is not
covered by JMusicBot's Apache-2.0 project license.

Version: 2.9.7 (upstream release tag v2.9.7)
Binary archive: https://github.com/denoland/deno/releases/download/v2.9.7/deno-x86_64-pc-windows-msvc.zip
Binary archive SHA-256: a0c3101b4158d1dfb7d6a78a7bf0f3de80c96bb423c152beec8beb22786f2238
Release: https://github.com/denoland/deno/releases/tag/v2.9.7
Source revision: 0c071246a412575e07423263404a5d13e7ed6aa2
Source tree: https://github.com/denoland/deno/tree/0c071246a412575e07423263404a5d13e7ed6aa2
Source archive: https://github.com/denoland/deno/archive/0c071246a412575e07423263404a5d13e7ed6aa2.tar.gz
Build workflow: https://github.com/denoland/deno/blob/0c071246a412575e07423263404a5d13e7ed6aa2/.github/workflows/ci.generated.yml
Dependency lock: https://github.com/denoland/deno/blob/0c071246a412575e07423263404a5d13e7ed6aa2/Cargo.lock

LICENSE.txt is the exact upstream MIT license and Deno author copyright
notice from this release. Retain its copyright and permission notice in all
copies or substantial portions of the software.

The pinned Cargo.lock uses Rusty V8 150.4.0. Its MIT copyright notice is
retained in RUSTY_V8_LICENSE.txt; the embedded V8 engine's BSD copyright,
terms and component notices are retained in V8_LICENSE.txt.
Rusty V8 source: https://github.com/denoland/rusty_v8/tree/v150.4.0
Rusty V8 build instructions: https://github.com/denoland/rusty_v8/tree/v150.4.0
V8 source revision: ac1e23989121713ca642f6650b34deff7b686896
V8 source: https://github.com/denoland/v8/tree/ac1e23989121713ca642f6650b34deff7b686896
V8 source archive: https://github.com/denoland/v8/archive/ac1e23989121713ca642f6650b34deff7b686896.tar.gz

NODE_TYPES_LICENSE.txt and UNDICI_TYPES_LICENSE.txt preserve the exact
notices of the Node and Undici type declarations embedded from this Deno
revision. Their original locations are cli/tsc/dts/node/LICENSE and
cli/tsc/dts/node/undici/LICENSE in the Deno source tree above.
Dependencies and their original license/source material remain identified
by the pinned Cargo.lock, upstream source tree and Rusty V8 submodule tree.
No modification to the redistributed executable is made by JMusicBot.
